== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from old Players Committee website news (issue #601). Sources used:
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221911/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/december02archives.htm December Updates] (6 December 2002): Card Vault review.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm April Updates] (1 April 2003): Online Affiliate Store with Universal Cards.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!] (2004): WebGroup and webmaster.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220030/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&new_topic News] (May–June 2006): Hackor Redux spoilers; the 'new' SWCCGPC.com.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20080925013637/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/ News (September 2008)] (already cited): login/cookie problem, 22 September 2008.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081017062757/http://swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php? News] (October 2008): 2008 site menu.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225913/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=6 New Service on the PC Store] (3 October 2008): pre-cut V slips.
=== Missing data ===
* WebGroup: the announcement page carries no date; the text says "By June 2004" from the capture date ([[Players Committee advocates]] dates the same announcement 24 May 2004).
* Card Vault: the December 2002 news only says "Ever heard of Card Vault? Read our review here"; the review itself, what the program did and who made it were not in the captured page, so they are left out.
* No wiki page for the Redux set; left unlinked.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* An earlier gap list said the 2008 site menu included shop.swccgpc.com and a Premium Membership. The 2008 news.php capture shows only Home, News, Events, Forums, Downloads, Rules, Card Directory, Store, Volunteer and "Who We Are"; the shop.swccgpc.com and Premium Membership links appear on the older PHP-Nuke site's menu (e.g. [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211140/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=94 sid=94, September 2008 capture]), so they were not added to the 2008 sentence.
* The V-slip seller posted as Shewski; the wiki's [[Shewski]] page identifies the handle as [[Mike Tomashewski]].

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 (downloads and rules wiki) ==
Added the sections "Download library (2006–2008)" and "Online Rules Database (2006–2009)". Sources: the PHP-Nuke Downloads module ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617215958/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads June 2006 main page]; category and Most Popular pages of October 2007), the relaunched site's /downloads/ category pages (September–October 2008), the /rules/ page (25 September 2008) and the /wiki/ pages (September 2007 – March 2009), all cited in the article.
=== Missing data ===
* The "Added on" dates of the virtual-set downloads in the 2007 module are placeholders that change between captures (31 December 1969, 30 November 2000, 30 November 2001, 30 November 2005); left out.
* File names show only for the deck list (Resources/swdecklist.pdf), the Prize Support Application (Resources/Prize_Support_Form.doc) and the command card (hosted on theforce.net); the 2008 item pages show Resources/virtual/hyperroute.pdf, Resources/virtual/CurrentErrataSheet.pdf and Resources/newsletter/encyclopedia.doc.
* Page 2 of the 2008 Virtual Cards and Enhanced Packs categories was not captured, so only the first ten items of each are known.
* The rules-wiki category pages are paged at 200 entries, so the total number of card-title and game-term rulings pages is not known.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The "Virtual Set 9 Spoiler" entry carries the description "Virtual Set 10 Spoiler"; the article gives the entry title only.
* "Icon Guide - version 2007" shows "Added on: 03-Jul-2006"; given as listed.
* The 2008 listing reads "Advanced Rulebook Quartlery Update"; the article says "quarterly update".
=== Marginal cuts ===
* The Spanish rulebook's description includes a personal e-mail address; omitted.
* The 2008 Virtual Cards listing names a lead designer and an official-text date for each of Virtual Sets 9–16; left for the virtual set pages.
